claims.text: The fee rests on a driver-pressed 'arrived' marker at 18:44:30, and that marker is not backed by the trace. POL-NS-01(b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence 'at or before the timestamp of that event'; on the exported trace the first fix inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius is at 18:44:45, fifteen seconds AFTER the tap, and there is no earlier in-radius fix from which the clock could run. The policy deliberately runs the waiting clock from GPS entry into the geofence and not from the driver tapping 'arrived'. POL-NS-05 only recomputes the clock where the marker is found FALSE - more than 300 m from the pin, or at 15 km/h or more - and the exported trace establishes neither threshold at 18:44:30; nor does POL-NS-12 rescue the marker, because trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON (a driver-pressed marker), not GPS_AUTO, so the platform's full-resolution arrival measurement is not in play. The platform, which asserts the fee, carries the burden on each limb of the conjunctive POL-NS-01, and limb (b) is not made out.

The driver never held position for the free waiting period in force. On his own trace the longest unbroken hold inside the arrival radius is 185 seconds (18:49:35 to 18:52:40) and the earlier hold is only 170 seconds (18:44:45 to 18:47:35); the free waiting period for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-01(c) requires the driver to have 'held position inside that geofence for a continuous dwell of at least' that period, and the trace shows precisely what the rider describes - the car at the bay, then away, then back, then cancelling. The rider's account that he 'never even stayed 5 minutes in one place' is corroborated to the second. The driver's answer will be POL-NS-06(i), which lets separate in-geofence intervals be summed where a kerb restriction (here the KERB_RESTRICTION advisory EV-ADVIS-00214-01) made holding position unlawful; but limb (i) is drafted as a qualification on the POL-NS-06 refund arithmetic - it presupposes the circling driver whose time 'should count' in that computation - and it cannot manufacture the continuous dwell that POL-NS-01(c) makes a condition of the charge itself.

Nothing turns on where the rider's own device was. POL-NS-06 makes the waiting-period test strict and directs that the fee be refunded 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The trace records no qualifying rider fix inside the 150 m rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), but rider presence is not a limb of POL-NS-01 and cannot convert a dwelling shortfall into a chargeable no-show.

The driver's own account confirms the gap the rider complains of. He posted at 18:45:10 that he was 'at the ION PHV bay along Orchard Turn'; the rider answered at 18:46:20 that she was 'coming down now'; and the trace puts his departure from the arrival radius at 18:47:35 - two minutes after his own locating message and 75 seconds after hers. For the whole of 18:47:35 to 18:49:35 the bay was empty while the rider was on her way down, and the total in-radius time the driver can point to is 355 seconds, under six minutes and by no measure the continuous period the charge requires.

The trip record satisfies limbs (a) and (d) of the baseline test: it carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:44:30 on 2026-08-07, and it shows the trip terminated by the driver at 18:52:45 with cancelled_by DRIVER, status CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and no started_at - one of the three recognised reason codes in limb (d).

The driver's trace places him inside the arrival geofence. The zone class is LARGE_VENUE (trip_record.pickup_zone_class), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, and the derived arrival block records two qualifying in-geofence runs carrying 40 qualifying fixes across 83 driver fixes at 100 percent coverage; the first qualifying run opens at 18:44:45. The driver was therefore inside the geofence, and the trace never removes him from it for longer than the bus-lane loop.

Limb (c)'s dwell requirement is met. The free waiting period in force is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec and not the 180 second default, and the derived arrival block computes the driver's in-geofence dwell at 355 seconds - a 170 second run from 18:44:45 to 18:47:35 and a 185 second run from 18:49:35 to 18:52:40 - giving a shortfall of minus 55 seconds. The minimum is met with 55 seconds to spare.

Summing the two intervals is exactly what POL-NS-06(i) permits here, and every condition of the limb is satisfied on the record: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is present and populated with type KERB_RESTRICTION (full-day bus lane, no stopping, waiting or picking up, 17:00-20:00, Orchard Road and Orchard Turn between Paterson Rd and Bideford Rd), its geometry covers the pickup road and its active window covers the whole waiting period, and the driver's furthest point between the holds was 179.0 m from the pin, well inside the 300 m leash. Holding the kerb was not lawfully possible, so the driver's circling time counts toward his dwell.

The bus-lane advisory corroborates the driver's account and not the rider's. He told the rider in chat at 18:47:50 - 'boss the marshal make me move, bus lane until 8pm. i go one round and come back same place ah' - and the trace shows precisely one excursion and return to the same bay, not an abandonment of the pickup. The driver kept the rider informed; what the trace records is compliance with an enforcement-restricted kerb.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on these facts. Limb (b) fails, because the driver did reply within 120 seconds of the rider's coordinating message: her 'ok coming down now' was sent at 18:46:20 and the driver answered at 18:47:50, 90 seconds later. Limb (c) also fails on the rider's own track, which records 0 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, her nearest fix being some 690.7 m from the pickup pin. On the rider's own device she was never at the pickup point, whatever the chat said.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the record contains no finding that at 18:44:30 the driver was more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above, and the derived arrival block places his first qualifying in-geofence run 15 seconds after the marker. Even if the marker were recomputed away, POL-NS-05(iii) preserves the fee, because the corrected dwell still meets the minimum - there is no shortfall to refund under limb (i) and no absence of in-geofence fixes to record under limb (ii).

The rider's objection that the driver 'never even stayed 5 minutes in one place' applies a test the policy does not use. The record shows the driver on site 8.3 minutes, from the 18:44:30 arrival to the 18:52:45 cancellation (trip_record.wait_time_min 8.3), with 355 seconds of in-geofence dwell against a 300 second minimum. POL-NS-06 measures dwell cumulatively precisely so that a driver moved on by a lawfully enforced bus lane is not penalised for obeying the law.

No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 is not reached, because the driver's stationary holds lie inside the 120 m arrival radius, not merely within the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling; POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall (minus 55 seconds on the record's own arithmetic) and does not refund; and the derived arrival block records that the POL-NS-06(i) summation is available rather than unavailable. The fee therefore stands as a verified no-show.

The driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 and the anti-farming check does not bite: 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in force is SGD 3.20, and driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 - below the threshold of 4 - against 118 completed trips in the same 30 days, so the rate limb of the check cannot be reached either and the compensation is not withheld. The disposition of the fee is NO_ACTION (the charge stands) and the ruling the case produces, per POL-GEN-03, is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.20.

Every artifact the driver relies on is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0: unbroken 10 second telemetry with 100 percent coverage and no gap anywhere near the waiting window, a five-message chat log consistent with trip_record.chat_message_count, and a fare line of SGD 4.00 reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No POL-GEN-02 disclosure discount and no POL-NS-08 impairment applies, and there is no POL-NS-09 trigger - the parties have no prior disputes with one another, the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and the anti-farming check does not trip.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this is a NO_SHOW_CHARGE dispute over the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee on trip TRP-00214. The fee stands and the driver is compensated SGD 3.20.

Rider - your refund is refused. The trace does not support the account that the driver never waited. POL-NS-02's arrival test is met: the driver's fixes sit inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius across two in-geofence runs carrying 40 qualifying fixes, the first opening at 18:44:45, so he was at the bay. You are right that he did not hold one uninterrupted five minutes - his two in-geofence holds are 170 seconds (18:44:45-18:47:35) and 185 seconds (18:49:35-18:52:40), which is why he cancelled when he did. But POL-NS-06(i) permits those separate intervals to be summed where holding position was not lawfully possible, and the artifact that limb requires is present: EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is an LTA KERB_RESTRICTION (full-day bus lane, no stopping, waiting or picking up) active 17:00-20:00 on exactly the pickup road, its geometry covers the trace and its window covers the whole wait, and the driver's single loop took him only 179 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash. That gives 355 seconds against the 300-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) - a 55-second surplus, so there is no shortfall and no refund under POL-NS-06. Your further point, that the 'arrived' tap at 18:44:30 falls 15 seconds before the first in-geofence fix at 18:44:45, does not change the result: the policy measures the waiting clock from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the tap (POL-NS-01(c)), POL-NS-05 does not find the marker false (no fix in the trace places the driver over 300 m away or moving at 15 km/h or more at that time), and POL-NS-12 is not engaged because the marker is a driver BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. A one-cadence-interval early tap is the sloppiness the clock rule is designed to absorb, not a false-arrival event. Where your own device sat is not a condition of the charge in any event - POL-NS-06 refunds 'whether or not the rider was present' - which does not help you here, because there is no shortfall to refund. Your route to POL-NS-04 also fails: the driver replied to your 'ok coming down now' (18:46:20) at 18:47:50, inside 120 seconds, and your track records no qualifying fix inside the 150 m rider-presence radius, so neither limb (b) nor limb (c) of that clause is made out.

Driver - you are paid. POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs: an 'arrived' event on the trip record (18:44:30), the trace placing you inside the geofence, an effective dwell of 355 seconds against the 300-second minimum, and termination by you at 18:52:45 under the recognised reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. POL-NS-07 fixes your compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force, SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not bite: your driver_profile records 2 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days - below the threshold of 4 - against 118 completed trips, a rate of 0.017, far below 0.08. The SGD 3.20 is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold and therefore executes on issue.

Confidence is 0.88. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts - the trip record, the GPS trace, the traffic advisory, the chat log and the fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02 disclosure discount applies and no limb of POL-NS-08 is met. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: the parties have no prior disputes with each other, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clear, so the case is not escalated. No clause on these facts produces a referral. The rider's SGD 4.00 charge stands and the SGD 3.20 to the driver is met from that fee, the platform retaining the residual 20 percent.

His holds were 170 s (18:44:45-18:47:35) and 185 s (18:49:35-18:52:40), 355 s in total, 55 s above the 300 s minimum. The driver's 18:47:50 chat message recording that the marshal moved him on matches the trace.

POL-NS-02 sets the arrival test - three consecutive in-radius fixes at 25 m accuracy or better, which this trace supplies 40 times over - and says that where qualifying in-radius fixes exist the arrival question is settled and the dispute turns on dwell. A 15-second difference, within the trace's 10-second cadence, does not defeat the fee.

On the rider's own device: the trace records no qualifying fix for her inside the 150 m rider-presence radius, her nearest fix being about 690 m from the pin (EV-GPS-00214). POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate her - limb (b) fails because the driver did reply within 120 seconds (her 18:46:20 message, his 18:47:50 reply, 90 seconds), and limb (c) fails on her own track. ruling.explanation:
Addressed to both parties.

Outcome: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands and is not refunded to the rider; the driver is paid SGD 3.20.

The charge depends on the four conjunctive conditions of POL-NS-01, and all four hold on this record.

(a) Arrival event: the trip record (EV-TRIP-00214) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:44:30 on 2026-08-07.

(b) Inside the pickup geofence: the pickup zone class is LARGE_VENUE, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00214) contains 40 qualifying in-radius fixes across two runs, and the driver never went more than 179.0 m from the pin. The rider's point is that the tap at 18:44:30 is about 15 seconds before the first recorded in-radius fix at 18:44:45. That does not break limb (b): POL-NS-05 makes a marker false only where a fix at the tap places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more, and neither is established here (driver speeds of 0.0 / 28.7 / 42.6 / 49.6 kph belong to the later loop, not the tap). A tap a few seconds before GPS entry is the sloppy-but-harmless case POL-NS-05 addresses, and POL-NS-02 itself provides that where qualifying in-radius fixes exist the arrival test is satisfied and the dispute turns on dwell, the dwell clock running from GPS entry (18:44:45) and not from the tap. Limb (b) does not fail.

(c) Dwell: the free waiting period in force is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (not the 180-second default). The effective in-geofence dwell is 355 seconds — a 170-second hold (18:44:45 to 18:47:35) and a 185-second hold (18:49:35 to 18:52:40) — a surplus of 55 seconds over the 300-second minimum. The two holds are properly summed under POL-NS-06(i): every condition of that limb is met, because the LTA bus-lane KERB_RESTRICTION advisory EV-ADVIS-00214-01 covers the pickup road (Orchard Road/Orchard Turn between Paterson Rd and Bideford Rd) with an active window of 17:00-20:00 covering the whole waiting period, so holding the kerb was not lawfully possible, and the driver's furthest point between the holds was 179.0 m, inside the 300 m leash. The rider's objection that the driver 'never even stayed 5 minutes in one place' (claims of the rider side on the longest single hold, 185 s and 170 s) is correct as raw numbers but applies the wrong test: POL-NS-06(i) exists precisely so that a driver moved on by an enforced bus lane is not penalised for obeying the law, and the accumulated dwell clears the minimum.

(d) Termination: the trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver at 18:52:45, status CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (a recognised code), with no boarding event and no started_at — after the required dwell had elapsed.

No clause displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 is not reached, because the driver's stationary holds lie inside the 120 m arrival radius rather than merely within the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, and the bay carries a single registered pickup point. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the driver replied in the chat at 18:47:50, within 120 seconds of the rider's 18:46:20 'coming down now' message, so limb (b) fails; and the rider's own track records 0 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius (her nearest fix is about 690.7 m from the pin), so limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes. That rider-presence point is true but immaterial — presence is not a limb of POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06 refunds 'whether or not the rider was present' — but here the arithmetic itself favours the driver, so the concession changes nothing. POL-NS-05 does not refund (no false marker). POL-NS-06 does not refund (no shortfall). POL-NS-10 is not engaged (the rider did not cancel). The driver's account that the marshal moved him on is corroborated by the chat (18:47:50, 'boss the marshal make me move, bus lane until 8pm...') and by the trace's single excursion and return; the 120-second bay-empty interval (18:47:35 to 18:49:35) that the rider points to is exactly that lawful loop, and it is counted only because POL-NS-06(i) allows it.

Driver's pay: POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, which is SGD 3.20 (matching the money block's derived driver_compensation of 3.20). The anti-farming check does not bite: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, so the rate limb against completed_trips_30d is not reached. The fee disposition is NO_ACTION (the charge stands), and per POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring the SGD 3.20 compensation.

Evidence quality: every artifact this ruling rests on is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes — the GPS trace is 100 percent covered with no gap near the waiting window, the chat log is complete at five messages consistent with trip_record.chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.00 fare line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No POL-GEN-02 disclosure discount and no POL-NS-08 impairment applies, no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present, and the deciding facts are not carried solely by any impaired artifact, so confidence is not capped below the floor.

The monetary effect is SGD 3.20, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.
